🔥 NEW at Chai Paratha Express 🔥
Now serving refreshing **V7 Soft Drinks** packed with **100% natural ingredients** and enriched with essential vitamins! 🥤✨

🍍 Pina Colada
🍎 Apple Malt

Beat the heat with a refreshing boost — perfect with your favorite Karachi-style meals, chai, and lachha paratha! ☕🥙

5775 Atlantic Drive, Mississauga
📞 Please call Tahir: 647-863-4644
